Controller edits / agent access
|-- @public(MappingDocumentController)
|   |-- @manages(snapshot: ControllerSnapshot, pendingNodeIds, listeners, nodeCache)
|   |-- @retains(context: CanvasEditingContext); @uses(diagrams, historyService)
|   |-- @state(document, canvas, version, canvasRevisionId, endpointBounds, cell)
|   `-- @calls(nodes, canvasDisplayNodes); @returns(structuredClone(nodeCache.nodes))
|-- @calls(transact(expectedVersion, operations), applyUpdate)
|   |-- @applyUpdate() => pendingNodeIds.clear(); try applyOperations(); finally clear()
|   |-- @requires(expectedVersion === snapshot.version; 1 <= operations.length <= 100)
|   `-- @applyOperations() => structuredClone(snapshot); stage(operations); updateSnapshot(..., true)
|-- @dispatch(DiagramOperation)
|   |-- @diagram-create => diagrams.create(); insertGridDiagram()
|   |-- @diagram-insert => diagrams.getRevision(); insertGridDiagram()
|   |-- @replace | patchDiagram | setSourceMappings | setJumps => prepareDiagramEdit()
|   |   |-- @calls(prepareDiagramEdit, diagrams.revise(document.scene.contents[id].revisionId, edit))
|   |   `-- @patchDiagram <- nodeIds + lineAfter => reanchor(edges, jumps, folds, sections)
|   |-- @diagram-revision-apply requires before.revisionId === expectedRevisionId
|   |   `-- @calls(receiveDiagramRevision, trackNodes, layoutScene, reconcileConnections)
|   |-- @edge-create | edge-update => parse(); validateConnectionAnchor(); document.edges
|   |-- @grid(move | collapse | group | remove) => updateGridBox | prune; layout | reconcile
|   `-- @floating(move | collapse | remove) => updateDisplayGeometry | setExpansion | removeDisplayNode
|-- @private(updateSnapshot)
|   |-- @reconciles(selection, focus, connections, jumps, diagramViews, floatingGeometry)
|   |-- @when(record) => historyService.append(context, document, canvas, pendingNodeIds)
|   |-- @canonicalizes(scene.contents <- diagrams.getRevision(revisionId).diagram)
|   `-- @publishes(snapshot, version + Number(increment)); listeners.forEach(call)
|-- @public(updateCanvas(value, record = false), select(command), undo(redo), reset())
|   |-- @select() => updateCanvas(updateSelection(...), true)
|   `-- @undo() => historyService.navigate(); @reset() => historyService.reset()
`-- @bridge(useAgentCanvasBridge(descriptor, handle, workspace))
    |-- @manages(canvasId, identity, abortController, timer, results: Map, agentStatus)
    |-- @register() => POST('/api/mapping/agent/canvases')
    |-- @poll(commands) => latest.current.handle(command); reply(command.id, result)
    |   |-- @cache(command.method !== 'context'); @capacity(results) <= 200
    |   `-- @context() requires encodedBytes <= 64 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024
    |-- @calls(publishLiveCanvasSelections, workspace, canvasId, liveEndpoint)
    `-- @cleanup() => abort(); clearTimeout(); unregister(); removeEventListener()
